test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Abhishek is the brother of Ashu who is the son of Jai. Swati is the daughter of Jyoti. Malti is the mother of Ashu and Jyoti.

How is Abhishek related to Swati?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Abhishek is the brother of Ashu who is the son of Jai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cbf6e4dbac5534ce82fa4f64c84f9a9d117d7c733b9b9e432de1b23a5085fa0.png] 

2) Malti is the mother of Ashu and Jyoti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6112bb1e1692ec5c0d583df8784b1fd87cbb2779d00a256e22641e39e46424fd.png] 

3) Swati is the daughter of Jyoti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f544737e2afa70cadd2c9c7dc762dab6d0827890d7630bc44e3d98d293d4fb91.png] 

Thus, Abhishek is the Swati's uncle.

As out of all the options mother's brother is given, therefore Abhishek is the Swati's maternal uncle or mother's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
